    Constructs a packing of 26 circles by placing them on a jittered

    # Create a 5x5 grid and add one extra to make 26
    # We use a slightly offset grid to mimic hexagonal packing
    centers = []
    rows, cols = 5, 5

            x = (c + 0.5 + (0.1 if r % 2 == 0 else -0.1)) / cols

    # Add the 26th circle near the center

    centers = np.array(centers[:n])
    
    # Simple iterative relaxation to spread circles

    Computes the maximum possible radii for the given centers.
    Uses a more robust iterative shrinking approach to ensure validity.
    """
    n = centers.shape[0]
    # Initial radii based on distance to boundaries

                    total = radii[i] + radii[j]
                    radii[i] *= (d / total)
                    radii[j] *= (d / total)
    return radii
